# ResetCameraProjectionMatrix

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Cameras](Blitz3D-Cameras)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ResetCameraProjectionMatrix:Void camera:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `camera` | In | Int32 | required | Camera handle. |

## Description

Takes the projection matrix of [SetCameraProjectionMatrix](SetCameraProjectionMatrix) away again. The camera then projects with [CameraZoom](CameraZoom), [CameraRange](CameraRange) and [CameraProjMode](CameraProjMode). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.
